answer: Proof of Personhood using cryptographically signed biometric entropy creates a trellis of trust that prevents Sybil proliferation. By anchoring identities to unique biological traits, the network ensures each agent flows like a lagoon restricted by an inlet of rigorous verification. An attacker seeking to flood this ecosystem must procure distinct human-verified credentials for every fake node, making the cost of mass identity fabrication prohibitively expensive compared to the potential network rewards.
